instruction: `parse_date` in `/repo/datekit/parse.py` rejects ISO 8601 timestamps that end in `Z`, such as `2026-09-27T10:00:00Z`. Fix it so a trailing `Z` means UTC. Keep the public API unchanged; the failing test is `tests/test_parse.py::test_trailing_z`.
